name: Philips Hue White Ambiance GU10 (350 lm, EU)

radios.note: Hue's pages for this EAN list Bluetooth and Hue Bridge control. Hue's Bridge FAQ says the Bridge runs a private Zigbee network for all Hue lights. Conrad also lists Zigbee.

matter.note: The product pages we saw don't mention Matter for this EAN and we found no CSA listing for it. Hue's guide offers Matter through the Hue Bridge. Not confirmed for the bulb itself.

apple_home.note: Via the Hue Bridge. Hue's Matter guide says the Bridge connects all Hue lights, including bulbs without Matter, to Apple Home, Google Home and Alexa.

google_home.note: Hue's page for this EAN lists Google Assistant under 'Hue Bridge required'. Hue's US FAQ describes bridgeless Bluetooth pairing with Nest devices, but that isn't confirmed for this EU bulb.

alexa.note: Hue's page for this EAN lists Alexa under 'Hue Bridge required'. Hue's US FAQ describes bridgeless Bluetooth pairing with Echo devices, but that isn't confirmed for this EU bulb.

smartthings.note: The pages we saw for this EAN don't mention SmartThings. Other Hue bulbs list it under 'Hue Bridge required', but we couldn't confirm it for this one.

home_assistant.note: Official Hue integration (via Hue Bridge) and official Hue BLE integration (since 2025.12, bridgeless Bluetooth). The BLE docs don't name this specific bulb.

hubRequired.note: Here this means needing a bridge for basic app control. The Hue app controls it over Bluetooth; voice assistants, Apple Home and the full feature set need a Hue Bridge.

localControl.note: Bluetooth control from a phone works without internet; Home Assistant talks to the Hue Bridge over its local API.

colorType.note: Adjustable white from 2200 to 6500 K; no colour.

summary: No longer sold in Hue's UK shop, the EU Philips Hue White Ambiance GU10 (EAN 8719514339903) works with Apple Home through a Hue Bridge, and Hue's product page lists Alexa and Google Assistant under 'Hue Bridge required' too. Without a bridge, the Hue app controls it over Bluetooth. It's a tunable white spotlight, 2200 to 6500 K, rated at 350 lumens. Home Assistant supports it through the official Hue and Hue BLE integrations; SmartThings isn't confirmed.
caveats: Hue's UK shop lists this EAN as no longer available; the successor (EAN 8720169229976) is rated at 400 lm, so check the EAN on the box.
Apple Home needs a Hue Bridge, and Hue's product page lists Alexa and Google Assistant under 'Hue Bridge required' as well.
SmartThings support isn't confirmed for this EAN.
